title: Unverified key

patterns: OP_DEPTH OP_0NOTEQUAL OP_NOTIF around a key
<key> CHECKSIG DROP with an empty signature
a 32-byte tapscript key that never has to verify

note: The hole in Knots #422, added to the fake-multisig check. A key beside CHECKSIG counts only when this spend shows a signature for it. OP_DEPTH OP_0NOTEQUAL OP_NOTIF around a key is marked, and so is a key then CHECKSIG DROP when the signature item is empty. In tapscript a key is 32 bytes; more than ten of those without a signature item are marked. A full-size item still counts as a signature. Verifying that item is the node's job, which is the rest of Knots #470.
